### Niagen Bioscience to Present at Longevity Investors Conference


September 2, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/770776702/files/doc_news/Niagen-Bioscience-to-Present-at-Longevity-Investors-Conference-2026.pdf)


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54597522&newsitemid=20260902223169&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=54ac3dcc4677860f8c64935d818624f4) (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announces that senior management will participate at the[Longevity Investors Conference](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.longevityinvestors.ch%2F&esheet=54597522&newsitemid=20260902223169&lan=en-US&anchor=Longevity+Investors+Conference&index=2&md5=29d560d7f29c38f3b5547b4ea27ed6ce) , taking place from September 14 to 17, 2026, in Gstaad, Switzerland.


Niagen Bioscience CEO, Rob Fried, will participate in the Longevity Goes Mainstream: The Investment Case for Consumer Health Panel on Wednesday, September 16, from 14:50 - 15:30 p.m. CEST. Additionally, Mr. Fried and Niagen Bioscience Chief Financial Officer & Head of Business Development, Ozan Pamir, will attend one-on-one meetings with investors in person throughout the conference. Attendees will also have the opportunity to sample Tru Niagen® on-site and experience Niagen™ Plus.


This year’s event will feature institutional investors, family offices, funds, and private investors with the world’s leading longevity scientists and key opinion leaders hosting panel discussions to create a forum aimed at amplifying breakthrough research and scientific advancement shaping the future of the longevity space.


If you would like to schedule a one-on-one meeting with the Niagen Bioscience management team during the conference, please contact your respective conference representative or emailNiagen@KCSA.com .


For additional information on Niagen Bioscience, visit[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54597522&newsitemid=20260902223169&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=3&md5=2d9fcdedf7744202de96e47fd71b0990) .


**About Niagen Bioscience**


[Niagen Bioscience, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com%2F&esheet=54597522&newsitemid=20260902223169&lan=en-US&anchor=Niagen+Bioscience%2C+Inc.&index=4&md5=91ef63b35ff133358237c4d430c03bee) (NASDAQ: NAGE) is the global authority in healthy aging and NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) science. As a trusted pioneer of NAD+ discoveries, Niagen Bioscience **™** is dedicated to advancing healthspan through precision science and innovative NAD+-boosting solutions.


The Niagen Bioscience team, composed of world-renowned scientists, works with independent investigators from esteemed universities and research institutions around the globe to uncover the full potential of NAD+. A vital coenzyme found in every cell of the human body, NAD+ declines with age and exposure to everyday lifestyle stressors. NAD+ depletion is a key contributor to age-related changes in health and vitality.


Distinguished by state-of-the-art laboratories, rigorous scientific and quality protocols, and collaborations with leading research institutions worldwide, Niagen Bioscience sets the gold standard for research, quality, and innovation. There’s a better way to age.


At the heart of its clinically tested product portfolio is Niagen® (patented nicotinamide riboside, or NR), the most efficient, well-researched, and high-quality NAD+ booster available. Niagen powers the Company’s consumer supplement, Tru Niagen®, the number one NAD+ boosting oral supplement in the United States† (available at[www.truniagen.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.truniagen.com&esheet=54597522&newsitemid=20260902223169&lan=en-US&anchor=www.truniagen.com&index=5&md5=a45b8074c93bb2c21c8f7c72385abf48) ), and Niagen™ Plus, featuring pharmaceutical-grade intravenous (IV) and injectable Niagen products ([www.niagenplus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenplus.com&esheet=54597522&newsitemid=20260902223169&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenplus.com&index=6&md5=346991c9ebe4026ac930635a078e26b0) ). Pharmaceutical-grade Niagen IV and injections are compounded and distributed by U.S. FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities and are available exclusively at clinics with a prescription. NAD Pharmaceuticals Corp., the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary focused on developing therapies for accelerated aging and rare genetic diseases, is conducting research on NB4168, a differentiated small molecule.


Niagen Bioscience’s robust patent portfolio protects NR and other NAD+ precursors. Niagen Bioscience maintains a website at[www.niagenbioscience.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.niagenbioscience.com&esheet=54597522&newsitemid=20260902223169&lan=en-US&anchor=www.niagenbioscience.com&index=7&md5=58cf5409997dfc1b23998164161facde) , where copies of press releases, news, and financial information are regularly published.
